headline: Brazil 2027 Inflation Forecast Rises to 4.76%
summary: Economists raised Brazil's inflation forecast for 2027 to 4.76% from 4.34% within one week, potentially giving the central bank less room to cut interest rates.
why: Inflation forecasts are critical indicators for central bank policy decisions, shaping interest rate trajectories and bond yields in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Higher inflation projections directly influence the central bank's rate-setting decisions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Upward revisions to long-term inflation expectations complicate the central bank's monetary easing cycle, altering rate expectations.
